related_questions.question: Is getting COVID as good as a vaccine?
related_questions.snippet: Vaccination is more reliable way to build protection than getting sick. COVID-19 vaccination helps protect people by creating an immune response without the potentially severe illness that can be associated with COVID-19 infection.

related_questions.question: Does having had COVID give you some immunity?
related_questions.snippet: Once you have had COVID-19, your immune system responds in several ways. This immune response can protect you against reinfection for several months, but this protection decreases over time. People with weakened immune systems who get an infection may have a limited immune response or none at all.

related_questions.question: Should you get the COVID vaccine even if you have already had COVID-19?
related_questions.snippet: You should get an updated COVID-19 vaccine even if you already had COVID-19. Staying up to date with COVID-19 vaccines after you recover from COVID-19 infection provides added protection against the virus that causes COVID-19. Talk to your doctor if you have questions about getting a COVID-19 vaccine.

related_questions.question: How many times have most people had COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: Most people have likely had COVID at least once. While reinfections are possible and increasingly common, the majority of individuals have experienced the virus only once, according to Jefferson Health. A study by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) found that most people experienced reinfection only once, with a smaller number experiencing it multiple times.

list.snippet: First infection is common: The initial infection with SARS-CoV-2 is widespread.
Reinfection is possible: Individuals can be infected multiple times.
Severity of reinfection: A study suggests that the severity of a reinfection tends to be similar to the first infection.
Long COVID: Long COVID can occur after either the first or subsequent infections.
Vaccination: Vaccination is correlated with a protective effect against severe infection, including reinfections.
